sections.title: Cargo names
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Master data > Cargo catalog > Cargo names

**Access rights:** Users with Master Data management rights

Use the path above to open the screen where you create a new cargo record.

![](/uploads/fec13a43a80ba62931e91f1a.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new cargo record.

![](/uploads/21b8578a391e067f00a0d242.png)

### Step 2

The system adds a new data row on the list view. Enter the cargo information.

![](/uploads/5503d5fd48dfdf86c205d067.png)

**Fields to fill in**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Cargo name | Enter the name of the cargo. |
| 2 | Cargo code | Enter the cargo code. The system does not allow duplicate codes. |
| 3 | Description | Enter a description of the cargo. |
| 4 | Active | Select this so the cargo is shown. |

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** to save what you have entered.

![](/uploads/8a3023f6742c52b50a3c7415.png)

## Result

The cargo record has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/e3cb7a2b65f2af2df4db35e5.png)

sections.title: Packaging specifications
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Master data > Packaging specifications

**Access rights:** Users with Master Data management rights

Use the path above to open the screen where you create a new packaging specification.

![](/uploads/8d51c7358232b27f22daeb2c.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new packaging specification.

![](/uploads/1ae55b6313a0e2b44cb356c6.png)

### Step 2

The system adds a new data row on the list view. Enter the packaging specification information.

![](/uploads/257c46fb2418823eedc1371e.png)

**General information**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Specification name | Enter the name of the specification. |
| 2 | Specification code | Enter the packaging specification code. The system does not allow duplicate codes. |
| 3 | Specification type | Select the type of specification. |
| 4 | Customer | Select the customer the packaging specification applies to. The specification then applies only to that customer. |
| 5 | Active | Select this so the packaging specification is shown. |

**Dimensions and weight**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 6 | Length (cm) | Enter the length. |
| 7 | Width (cm) | Enter the width. |
| 8 | Height (cm) | Enter the height. |
| 9 | Weight (kg) | Enter the weight of the packaging specification. |

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** to save what you have entered.

![](/uploads/4c1b379056520dbd4bf71885.png)

## Result

The packaging specification has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/fa35f47df0f894a15d87565e.png)
